effect.name: Spectrogram (Switch)
effect.description: The shader creates a pseudo audio spectrogram effect.
effect.author: Foxioo, (Thanks for the idea, Andrimal)

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Spectrogram (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.28 */
parameter.description: The shader creates a pseudo audio spectrogram effect.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable manages which color will be reduced. Set to 0 is the blend color will be reduced and set to 1 is the base color will be reduced.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Time
parameter.description: The variable defines the time positions of the distortion animation.
